newsitem.title: USA: Bank United moves up tender offer exp date.
newsitem.headline: Bank United moves up tender offer exp date.

text.p: Bank United Corp said on Wednesday it had moved up the expiration date for its tender offer and consent solicitation for its oustanding 8.05 percent senior notes from July 23 to May 7.

Under the terms of the tender offer and consent solicitation, tenders of senior notes, due May 15, may be withdrawn and the related consents may be revoked at any time prior to midnight, New York city time, on April 23, but subject to limited exceptions, not thereafter, the company said. If the expiration date is not extended past May 7, the price determination date for the tender offer would be May 2, the company added. Bank United said it had been informed by the depository for the tender offer that as of the close of business on April 21, $114.5 million in aggregated principal amount of senior notes had been tendered and consents had been provided.
That figure represented about 99.6 percent of the $115 million senior notes outstanding, the company said.
Bank United operates a community banking network in Texas and a financial markets business.
